record.how: one row per MJCF hinge. Side a is the XL330 instance nearest the joint origin in the parent/child body; side b is FOUND BY MEASUREMENT: the placed interface accepting the connection that lies on the joint axis (< 2 mm), searched in the CHILD body first and then in the PARENT — because on this machine four hinges put the servo in the child link and bolt its horn to a bracket in the parent. Every row records `in_body` and `side_of_joint`, and any other on-axis candidate under `other_candidates_on_axis`. Unresolved sides are null and named in `todo`.
